traits.flower_symmetry.note: APweb (read 2026-10-16): flowers asymmetric with a labellum.

traits.flowering_position.note: APweb (read 2026-10-16): Lowiaceae flowers single in leaf axils (axillary).

traits.phyllotaxis_pattern.note: Simpson, Plant Systematics (2019) p. 50, family Lowiaceae: phyllotaxis pattern distichous, usually; read as {"distichous": "usually"}.

traits.perennation.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Lowiaceae: how its perennial herbs last from year to year (character 25), coded usually a rhizome.
